A routine app\nthat moves with you.
Write your daily routine once. The app reminds you of each step at the right time. If you run late, it moves the rest of the day for you and tells you what it moved.
You wake up 40 minutes late. Nine alarms still ring at the old times. You miss most of them, feel behind all morning, and mute the app by Thursday.
You tap Running late. Every step moves 40 minutes. Gym stays where it is, because it is booked. Nothing rings for a step you already did.
Set a time, or say 20 minutes after the gym, or give a window. Move one step and the ones after it move too.

What it does, what it does not, and where your data is.
Build or Break runs the daily routine you already have. You write your steps once, the app reminds you of each one at the right time, and if your day runs late it moves the rest of the day for you.
It does not write a routine for you, it does not need an account, and it does not use the internet.
Everything you enter stays on this phone. Your plan, your history and your numbers live in one file here. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
Made by Yatharth Rathi, one person, in India. Questions and problems: yatharthmaheshwari01@gmail.com
The code is open source under the MIT licence.
This app collects nothing about you. It has no account, no server and no internet permission. Everything you type stays on your phone.
What is stored on your phone

Your routine, the steps you marked done or skipped, any reasons you gave, any numbers you logged (like weight or minutes), your goal, and a small log of when alarms were set and when they rang. All of it is in the app\'s private storage on this device.

Nothing, unless you choose to export. Export makes one file and hands it to the app you pick, like email or Drive. From that point the file is under that app\'s rules, not ours. There are no analytics, no crash reports and no ads.

Alarms and reminders: so a step can ring at an exact minute. Notifications: so a reminder can reach you. Full screen alarms: so an alarm can show over the lock screen. Battery: so your phone does not silence alarms to save power. Each one is optional. The app works without them, just quieter.
Settings has a Delete everything button. It removes every plan, every day of history and every alarm. Uninstalling the app does the same. There is no copy anywhere else to delete.
The app is not aimed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect anything from anyone, of any age.
If this policy changes, the new version will be in the app with a new date at the top. The promise that nothing leaves your phone will not change.
Build or Break is free to use for your own personal routine. Use it as it is meant to be used and do not try to break it or copy it off as your own.

The app does everything it can to ring on time, and it tells you honestly what your phone is allowing. But phone makers, battery savers and Android itself can delay or silence alarms. Do not rely on this app alone for anything where a missed alarm would cause harm, like medication or a flight.
Routines, goals, weights and minutes in this app are your own numbers. The app does not give health, fitness or medical advice. Talk to a professional for that.
Everything you enter belongs to you and stays on your phone. You can export it or delete it at any time. Because there is no server copy, a lost phone means lost data unless you exported.
The app\'s code is published under the MIT licence. It is provided as is, without any warranty. Nobody is liable for damages that come from using it, to the extent the law allows.
